title: ID0370506-DC/SICD/DE-[MP / R4 170001714]-could not access the column remotely via the port 502
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
We want to integrate the charging station at the Seitz car dealership into the DLM
incorporate. There is a Beck storage system on site, through which the column is connected as in
Deggendorf. For the time being, we don't have any
Problem with the fuse, there is enough power for 160kW
Charging power available. However, the column still has to be used for about 5
years to 100 kW.
We could not access the column remotely via the port
502.
We would like to add the IP to the column, as we did with Deggendorf.
192.168.88.160 Assign
Root cause:
Solution:
ELMS issue is solved. AC Income Meter part of the sales team to clarify with the customer
